item.description: The Finnish Long Drink Zero Sugar Cocktail Can
item.romanceDescription:
Experience the drink beloved by Finland for over 70 years when you sip The Long Drink, Traditional. Unlike seltzers or hard ciders made with fermented sugar, Long Drink is made with award-winning liquor that is smooth and doesn't leave you with a full beer feeling. Gluten free and all natural with zero sugar, The Long Drink Zero offers a balanced mix of gin, grapefruit and juniper berry flavors.

  • Twelve 12 fl oz cans of The Finnish Long Drink, Zero
  • Long Drink Zero is a citrus soda with real liquor and zero sugar for a delicious flavor everyone loves
  • Zero sugar drinks made with gin and natural grapefruit and juniper flavors for incredibly crisp and refreshing ready to drink cocktails
  • The Long Drink Zero is made with high quality, real liquor, unlike hard seltzer or hard cider, for that first sip feeling
  • 12 pack of cocktail drinks are the perfect alcoholic beverages for enjoying with friends outside or for a relaxing night at home
  • Each 12 fl oz can contains 5% alcohol by volume and should be enjoyed responsibly
  • The Finnish Legend of 1952
